shortBio.en: Pearl Jam rhythm guitar; Mother Love Bone / Green River DNA into Ten.
shortBio.zh: Pearl Jam 节奏吉他；Mother Love Bone / Green River DNA 带进 Ten。

body.en:
Born 1966. Brings Green River/Mother Love Bone rhythm writing into Pearl Jam with Ament. Co-architect of Ten open-chord grind beside McCready leads.

Seattle personnel continuity into stadium grunge.
body.zh:
1966 年生。与 Ament 把 Green River/Mother Love Bone 节奏写作带进 Pearl Jam。在 McCready 主音旁共建 Ten 开放和弦碾磨。

西雅图人事连续性进入体育场 grunge。
